subject: Trading
title: The Halving Cycle
description: A fast breakdown of The Halving Cycle for builders.

hook.text: Every four years, Bitcoin's mining reward is cut in half. The supply shock has preceded every major rally.

buildup.text: Satoshi coded a hard cap: only 21 million bitcoin will ever exist. Halvings enforce that scarcity.

discovery.text: In 2009 the reward was 50 BTC per block. By 2024 it dropped to 3.125. By 2140 it reaches zero.

twist.text: Halvings reduce new supply while demand may stay constant—basic economics predicts a price squeeze.

climax.text: Past halvings in 2012, 2016, and 2020 all preceded massive bull runs, though cause is debated.

punchline.text: Scarcity is programmed into every block.

quiz.question: What happens during a Bitcoin halving?
options: The mining reward per block is cut in half
Half of all Bitcoin is burned
